name: pm
description: PM helpers for team Linear workflows. Skills for the weekly grooming loop (per-person WIP), plan-to-tickets breakdown (assignee-aware), chart-first mapping of efforts too large to plan in one session, questionnaires that pull a blocking decision out of someone else's head, and end-of-cycle retro notes (attribution + Linear-first output). Composes with the linear plugin; ndr and librarian integrations are optional externals.

interface.shortDescription: Weekly grooming, breakdown, and cycle retros for Linear
interface.longDescription: PM helpers for team Linear workflows — weekly backlog grooming with per-person WIP, plan-to-tickets breakdown into assignee-aware vertical slices, and end-of-cycle retro notes with attribution and Linear-first output.
defaultPrompt: Groom the backlog for this cycle.
